entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. To make sure I understand, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The pulse reading is completely wrong, and now it won't sync with my phone at all. The whole thing is basically broken.
I see, that definitely sounds frustrating. It sounds like the unit may be defective. Let me pull up your account... Okay, I see your order. It looks like it was delivered 10 days ago, on January 8th.

Of course. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment... Okay, according to our policy here, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund for you right now.

Absolutely. I've just processed that for you. You should receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the defective item, we will issue your refund.
Whatever. A lot of hassle for something that should have worked out of the box.
I completely understand and I do apologize for the inconvenience. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
